To:
inquiries@escapemode.co.uk
From:
dhutchins@hamptonfarms.co.uk
Date:
12 January
Subject:
Playground renovations
Hello. I am the facilities manager at Hampton Farms Estate in Bostwick. I oversee the
updates of some shared spaces on our property, including replacing most of our
playground equipment.
I was referred by my counterpart at Crestview Village, Feng Tao. The project at Crestview
Village included many of the same features we are looking for, though we would like a
bigger splash pad. Could you please call me at 079 5555 6004 at your earliest
convenience? I would like to discuss your timeline and warranty, among other things.
Ideally, we would like to see a design proposal by mid-March and have the work
completed prior to 1 June.
Best wishes,
Delia Hutchins
Escape Mode, Inc.

Installation completed: 14 May
Payment due: 31 May

106
Hampton Farms Newsletter, 15 June
Volume 9, Issue 6
Just in time for summer, Hampton Farms has reopened its enhanced recreational
spaces. At the east playground, adjacent to the swimming pool, you will find Tilley's
Tracks and Explorer's Post play structures. On the west playground, children can enjoy
the Sunny Heights play structure and Daisy's Cool Zone, a splash pad that can
accommodate up to 20 people at once. Swing sets and sandboxes in both playgrounds
were unchanged, although new mulch was added as needed. The rotting wooden
benches and picnic tables at both playground areas have been replaced with sturdier
versions made from recycled plastic. What's more, you'll find more chairs and
umbrellas at the poolside. We hope these upgrades will delight residents and their
guests.
